thread:
Nina (CSM): Kickoff: AetherX Health onboarding. Objective: 30-day pilot -> production-ready checklist. Need alignment on stakeholders, pilot success rubric, access, and renewal/risks. Please claim items and flag blockers by EOD.
Ravi (CS Ops): Adding stakeholders and external DRIs. Customer DRI is @michaela_prod. I'll request the SSO metadata and cloud account details today.
Kai (Solutions Eng): I’ll lead the integration walkthrough and create a tiny sample app for them. Propose Wed 11am PT for a 30m demo + 15m Q&A.
Priya (Eng): For performance targets, what's acceptable p95 and peak qps? We should decide hosted vs. dedicated pilot to set expectations.
Tess (Product): Customer asked for three prioritized flows: triage-chat, clinical-note summarization, and insights rerank. Success rubric suggestion:
  - Flow parity: each flow passes automated smoke tests
  - Latency target: p95 < 400ms on pilot traffic profile
  - Quality floor: human review pass rate >= 85% on sample prompts
  - Budget guardrail: estimated monthly cost <= agreed cap
If we agree, I'll formalize into the playbook.
Omar (Finance): We'll produce a one-page estimate and a spend-variance threshold (10%). If they exceed that, auto-notify CS + AM. Need their billing contact.
Diego (Security): My checklist: SSO, KMS integration, retention and export controls, and a data classification note. Also need to confirm whether any PHI will be sent to our hosted environment. If PHI is expected, pilot must be private/VPC.
Zoe (Data): For regression checks I'll need 25 de-identified prompt-output pairs and any preferred scoring rubric. I can also set up a lightweight human-in-the-loop review workflow.
Nina (CSM): Proposed 4-phase plan:
  - Phase 0 (preflight, 3 days): access, SSO, billing contact, sample data handoff
  - Phase 1 (integration, Days 4-10): SDK demo, quickstarts, smoke tests
  - Phase 2 (stability & perf, Days 11-20): canary rollout, p95 tuning, cache sizing
  - Phase 3 (quality & handoff, Days 21-30): human review, final billing signoff, handoff docs
Please call out if timeline conflicts with any team calendars.
Ravi (CS Ops): I'll create the shared onboarding checklist in the customer folder and put in calendar invites for the demo.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Quick example I'll include in the repo for their engineers:

```
# quickstart
export AETHERX_KEY=...
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H \"Authorization: Bearer $AETHERX_KEY\" -d '{\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Summarize patient visit notes\"}]}'
```

I'll also attach a minimal CI smoke test they can run on deploy.
Priya (Eng): Technical asks: sample request distribution (tokens per request), expected concurrency, and whether they will use streaming. Also we need contact for their infra to open firewall/CIDR for VPC.
Tess (Product): Adoption triggers for renewal health: 1) 100 total interactions across flows by Day 14 OR 2) product team reports integrated dashboards for two flows. If neither hits, mark renewal risk as elevated and prepare activation playbook.
Omar (Finance): Action for customer finance: review estimate by Day 7. If not approved, we temporarily limit pilot spend.
Diego (Security): If they confirm no PHI, we can run hosted pilot with KMS + SSO. If PHI, we will need a VPC deployment; that adds ~5 business days. Flagging as potential blocker.
Zoe (Data): I'll prepare a shared doc for prompt collection, with an option to upload synthetic data. Also will schedule two 1-hr review sessions in Week3 for human eval.
Nina (CSM): Owners & deadlines (confirm):
  - SSO metadata + billing contact 9' Nina 9' due: tomorrow
  - SDK quickstart + demo slot 9' Kai 9' due: Wed 11am PT
  - Sample prompts (25) 9' Zoe 9' due: Fri
  - Infra allowlist + CIDR 9' Priya/Ravi 9' due: Day3
  - Finance estimate 9' Omar 9' due: Day7
  - Security signoff (PHI check) 9' Diego 9' due: Day1
Nina (CSM): Also setting up a lightweight feedback check at Day14: 3-question survey + one free-text on friction points. We'll capture results and fold into the Week3 review.
Ravi (CS Ops): Calendar invites sent for Wed demo. I attached the onboarding checklist link in the channel.
Kai (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll push the repo and include the CI smoke test sample.
Priya (Eng): Noted. Will need sample traces to model p95 9' please share 100 representative requests if available.
Diego (Security): Will confirm PHI status today and follow up.
Zoe (Data): :thumbsup: I'll post the prompt template and invite for Week3 reviews.
Omar (Finance): :thumbsup: will prepare estimate.
